text: {"title":"API Errors — Last Hour","timeRange":{"from":"now-1h","to":"now"},"refreshIntervalMs":15000,"panels":[{"id":"api-errors-total","title":"API errors (total)","viz":"stat","description":"Total count of error-level log lines emitted by the api app over the last hour, as a single number.","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"sum(count_over_time({app=\"api\", level=\"error\"}[1h]))","instant":true},"options":{"compact":true,"sparkline":true},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"api-errors-by-container","title":"API errors by container","viz":"bar","description":"Count of error-level api log lines over the last hour, broken down per container so the noisiest instance is visible.","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"sum by (container) (count_over_time({app=\"api\", level=\"error\"}[1h]))","instant":true},"options":{"compact":true,"legend":"none","yAxis":{"min":0,"label":"errors"}},"layout":{"x":6,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"api-error-rate","title":"API error rate over time","viz":"line","description":"Per-second rate of error-level api log lines over the window, one series per container.","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"sum by (container) (rate({app=\"api\", level=\"error\"}[5m]))"},"options":{"unit":"err/s","decimals":3,"compact":true,"legend":"bottom","yAxis":{"min":0,"label":"errors/s"}},"layout":{"x":0,"y":4,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"api-error-lines","title":"API error log lines","viz":"logs","description":"The raw error-level log lines from the api app, newest first, with each line's timestamp, message and labels.","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"{app=\"api\", level=\"error\"}"},"options":{"level":"level","limit":200,"order":"newest","showTime":true,"wrap":true,"levels":[{"state":"error","color":"danger"},{"state":"warn","color":"warning"},{"state":"info","color":"info"},{"state":"debug","color":"neutral"}]},"layout":{"x":6,"y":4,"w":6,"h":4}}]}
